# Breejesh Rathod

> Engineering leader and software developer with experience taking products from 0→1 and scaling them 1→100 across fintech, cybersecurity, and enterprise software. Technical blog, open-source projects, and engineering leadership.

## About

- [Homepage](https://breejeshrathod.com/): Portfolio homepage with introduction, about section, and contact information.
- [Experience](https://breejeshrathod.com/experience): Professional experience across engineering leadership roles in fintech, cybersecurity, and enterprise software.
- [Projects](https://breejeshrathod.com/projects): Featured open-source projects and applications built by Breejesh Rathod.
- [Achievements](https://breejeshrathod.com/achievements): Awards, certifications, and career milestones.
- [Blog](https://breejeshrathod.com/blog): Technical articles on system design, Java Loom/virtual threads, LLM agent architectures, distributed databases, cloud engineering, and Cracking the Coding Interview (CTCI) solutions.

- [Route Between Nodes: Path Search in a Directed Graph (Java)](https://breejeshrathod.com/blog/en/ctci-4-1-route-between-nodes): CTCI-style problem 4.1 for beginners: given a directed graph, decide if there is a route from node S to node E. BFS preferred over DFS, with a simple GraphNode neighbors list in Java. (Published: 2025-08-05)
- [Permutations with Dups: Unique Strings via Frequency Map (Java)](https://breejeshrathod.com/blog/en/ctci-8-8-permutations-with-dups): CTCI-style problem 8.8 for beginners: list every unique permutation of a string that may contain duplicate characters. Build a frequency map, backtrack by remaining counts, skip the n! blowup of naive swaps. (Published: 2025-08-03)
- [Private Constructor: Inaccessible Constructors & Singleton Pattern in Java (CTCI 13.1)](https://breejeshrathod.com/blog/en/ctci-13-1-private-constructor): CTCI problem 13.1: why and how private constructors are used in Java for Singleton pattern and utility classes. (Published: 2025-08-02)
- [Copy Node: Deep Copy a Graph / Data Structure in C++ (CTCI 12.8)](https://breejeshrathod.com/blog/en/ctci-12-8-copy-node): CTCI problem 12.8: deep copying a data structure containing pointers and cycle references using std::map pointer lookup. (Published: 2025-08-01)
